gloss_en: Verse fragment (Psalms 119:109): 'and Your Torah I have not forgotten' (ve-Toratekha lo shakhachti) — the conclusion of 'My soul is in my hands always,' expounded in LM I:46 as the memory-preserving effect (segula for zikaron, averting forgetfulness/mochin de-katnut) attained through clapping the hands during prayer
